protocol.status: Declared before observing any new AG News or CIFAR10 head test outcomes
protocol.features: Exactly the shared frozen encoders and train-only PCA produced by next/encoder
protocol.width_policy: Use the nearest v2 width to 6000 parameters for full/full_sigmoid; component deletions keep that same width, with lower actual trainable counts reported
protocol.full_kernel: Normalized complete A7 call and explicitly C1-modified first-hit risk, compiled from float64 into a validated float32 Hermite table; financial parameters fixed
protocol.full_sigmoid: Change only q to sigmoid(2*z), retain the complete-model Call and all neural structure; slope at z=0 differs and is not claimed matched
protocol.no_call: Remove restoration Call gain and replace Call-based write shape with relu(score)^2/(1+relu(score)^2), retaining an ordinary C1 closed region
protocol.no_recovery: Remove slow recovery dynamics and its readout
protocol.static_boundary: Remove input and memory dependence of the learned boundary coordinate
protocol.no_memory: Remove residual memory and candidate projection; retain fast/slow continuous neuron states
protocol.memory_only: Ordinary sigmoid read gate and ordinary C1 write shape with residual memory; remove both financial gate functions and fast/slow neuron dynamics
protocol.checkpoint_selection: Minimum clean validation cross entropy every 50 updates
protocol.test_use: Clean and raw-input-corrupted test are evaluated only after the fixed training protocol; no test tuning
protocol.interpretation: Component deletion is width-matched, not parameter-matched. Full versus full_sigmoid is exactly parameter-matched. Shared fixed financial lookup coefficients are reported separately from trainable parameters.
claims_not_presupposed: Either modality implies joint multimodal consistency
Approximate LUT derivatives equal the original formula exactly
